scope: Actual compiled native RTC tick/calendar and bounded alarm callbacks; Actual pinned SDK IRQ wrapper and common dispatcher, all enabled/pending six-event masks, channel bounds 0/1/4, ordered MMIO writes and callbacks; callback disabling/enabling pending events and replacing handler
limitations: W1C event/interrupt behavior is a controlled MMIO model. IRQ callbacks are fixtures by default; --real-tick executes actual native tick/calendar with alarm and handler-replacement fixtures. Physical interrupt delivery, concurrency, timing and whole-image equality remain unproven.
Original wrapper ownership extent162 is held as a boundary discrepancy; native wrapper bytes16 are supplemental.
